name: Emma Aldridge
bioAdditions: Savage records that Thomas Topping joined the Milford church with his wife Emma in 1640 and had Elnathan baptized on 2 Aug 1640. Thomas's next marriage contract is dated 20 Oct 1666 (S1). So Emma was the mother of Capt. Elnathan (S1).

openQuestionsResolved.question: Was she the mother of Elnathan (b. 1640), given Thomas's three marriages?
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Yes. Thomas and wife Emma joined the Milford church in 1640, the year Elnathan was baptized (2 Aug 1640); his second marriage was in 1666.

sources.citation: James Savage, A Genealogical Dictionary of the First Settlers of New England, vol. 4 (1862), p. 255, entry TAPPAN/TOPPING, Thomas of Milford
